description: This source file defines API endpoints for managing doctor time slots in a healthcare appointment system. It includes operations for listing available slots, listing a doctor's own slots, creating, deleting, and updating time slots. The file leverages FastAPI for routing, SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions, and includes authentication dependencies.

methods.name: get_current_doctor(db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves the currently authenticated doctor profile, ensuring the user is of type DOCTOR.

methods.name: list_available_timeslots( doctor_id: int, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), )
methods.description: Lists all unbooked, future time slots for a specified doctor.

methods.name: list_my_timeslots( db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), doctor: models.Doctor = Depends(get_current_doctor) )
methods.description: Lists all time slots (booked and unbooked) for the authenticated doctor.

methods.name: create_timeslot( slot: schemas.TimeSlotCreate, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), doctor: models.Doctor = Depends(get_current_doctor) )
methods.description: Creates a new available time slot for the authenticated doctor.

methods.name: delete_timeslot( slot_id: int, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), doctor: models.Doctor = Depends(get_current_doctor) )
methods.description: Deletes a specific time slot if it belongs to the authenticated doctor and is not booked.

methods.name: update_timeslot( slot_id: int, slot_update: schemas.TimeSlotCreate, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), doctor: models.Doctor = Depends(get_current_doctor) )
methods.description: Updates start/end times for a specific time slot owned by the authenticated doctor, if not booked.
